name: dobe_relax_key
desc: Keep the full nelson exactly, but the Doberman settles down lower and leans back comfortably as if lounging, its goo body sinking and spreading wider into the puddle, the cat still locked in its arms and now held lower, close to the puddle. The Doberman looks relaxed and smug, waiting, eyes half-lidded. Same designs, colors, marble, outline and pixel art style.
